description: Required and optional fields for a Zeek dns.log record delivered as one Kafka JSON message.

requiredFields.name: id
requiredFields.notes: Zeek uid; with trans_id and the sensor it forms the event id sensor:uid:trans_id

requiredFields.name: ts
requiredFields.notes: epoch seconds, fractional part allowed; negative rejected; stored at millisecond precision

requiredFields.name: id_orig_h
requiredFields.notes: the querier's address; part of the rolling window's key, together with the sensor and log type

requiredFields.name: trans_id
requiredFields.notes: disambiguates records that legitimately share a uid when a resolver reuses one connection for many queries

requiredFields.name: query
requiredFields.notes: blank rejected; never stored raw, only derived into numeric features

requiredFields.name: qtype
requiredFields.notes: IANA RR type code; absent rejected; an unrecognised code maps to OTHER

optionalFields.name: rcode
optionalFields.notes: absent means no response was seen

optionalFields.name: AA
optionalFields.notes: authoritative-answer flag; Zeek writes AA, RA and TC as false whether or not a response occurred, so only rcode indicates a response was seen

optionalFields.name: RA
optionalFields.notes: recursion-available flag; same caveat as AA

optionalFields.name: TC
optionalFields.notes: truncated flag; same caveat as AA

optionalFields.name: answers
optionalFields.notes: array of strings, one per answer record; only the count is used

optionalFields.name: TTLs
optionalFields.notes: array of numbers, in seconds; null elements tolerated; only the first element is used

invalidRecordPolicy: Malformed JSON or a missing required field routes to netsec.dns.dlq.v1 with a reason code; unknown additive fields are tolerated and ignored.
